title: The Mughals Conspiracy Against Banda Singh And their Eulogy of (Tat Khalsa) Singhs

blocks.text: Mughal vakils keep approaching the Singhs with respectful language, oaths, and material promises, hoping to settle them under controlled favor rather than face them in full battle.
Tax remissions, lands, and safe arrangements are offered, but the Khalsa remains wary and unwilling to be fixed too easily in one political frame.
Vakils are the essential anchor because mediation, not open battle, dominates the page.
